qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of the -s (or -secure) option in the Bi Impl Nx driver shim?
qa_pairs.output: In the Bi Impl Nx driver shim, the -s or -secure option secures the driver by creating SSL certificates and then exits the program.

qa_pairs.instruction: What does the -p (or -password) option configure for the Bi Impl Nx driver shim?
qa_pairs.output: The -p or -password option for the Bi Impl Nx driver shim specifies the Remote Loader password.

qa_pairs.instruction: List the command line options used to set up SSL certificates in the Bi Impl Nx driver shim and describe each.
qa_pairs.output:
Table of SSL‑certificate options for the Bi Impl Nx driver shim:

| Option (Short and Long Forms) | Description |
| -s  -secure | Secures the driver by creating SSL certificates, then exits. |
| -p  -password | Specifies the Remote Loader password. |

qa_pairs.instruction: What are the general command line options for the Bi Impl Nx driver shim and what is the default configuration file?
qa_pairs.output:
General options for the Bi Impl Nx driver shim:

| Option (Short and Long Forms) | Description |
| -c <congFile>  -config <configFile> | Instructs the driver shim to read options from the specified configuration file. Options are read from /etc/nxdrv.conf by default. |
| -?  -help | Displays the command line options, then exits. |
| -v  -version | Displays the driver shim version and build date, then exits. |

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you display the version and build date of the Bi Impl Nx driver shim from the command line?
qa_pairs.output: Run the Bi Impl Nx driver shim with either the -v or -version option; the shim will print its version and build date and then exit.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you show the help information for the Bi Impl Nx driver shim?
qa_pairs.output: Invoke the Bi Impl Nx driver shim with either the -? or -help option; the shim will display all command line options and then exit.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you instruct the Bi Impl Nx driver shim to read its options from a custom configuration file named custom.conf?
qa_pairs.output: Use the -c custom.conf or -config custom.conf option when launching the Bi Impl Nx driver shim; this tells the shim to read options from the specified custom configuration file instead of the default /etc/nxdrv.conf.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the command line options available for the Bi Impl Nx driver shim.
qa_pairs.output:
The Bi Impl Nx driver shim supports the following command line options:
- SSL certificate setup: -s/-secure (creates SSL certificates and exits) and -p/-password (specifies Remote Loader password).
- General configuration: -c <file> / -config <file> (reads options from a specified file, default /etc/nxdrv.conf), -? / -help (displays help), and -v / -version (displays version and build date).
